pr_b.title: Tell logind when the session locks
pr_b.body: ## Summary The lock never tells logind about itself: `LockedHint` stays `no` while locked, and no `Lock` signal goes out. Programs that watch logind can't see the lock. KeePassXC, for example, locks its databases on the `Lock` signal, so on Omarchy it stays unlocked. See also #9076. Send `Session.Lock()` when a lock is requested.
